schema.description:
Task type:

- **offline**: offline task, such as offline transcription

- **realtime**: real-time task, such as creating a real-time recording

Operation type. Valid values:

- start: start the task. This is the default value. You usually do not need to set it explicitly.

- stop: stop a real-time meeting task. Set this to stop after the meeting ends. Use this only for real-time meeting scenarios.

Note: When ending a real-time recording, you must set this parameter to stop.

AppKey.description: The AppKey of your project, created in the Alibaba Cloud console.

Input.description:
Basic input parameters for the task. Required parameters vary by task type.

- For offline tasks, set SourceLanguage and FileUrl.

- For realtime tasks, also set SourceLanguage, Format, and SampleRate.

SourceLanguage.description:
The language model used for speech recognition. Valid values:

- **cn**: Chinese

- **en**: English

- **fspk**: Chinese and English mixed

- **ja**: Japanese

- **yue**: Cantonese

FileUrl.description: The HTTP or HTTPS URL of the source audio or video file for an offline transcription task.

TaskKey.description: A custom ID that you set to associate with this task.

Format.description:
The encoding format of the audio stream for a real-time meeting. Valid values:

- **pcm**

- **opus**

- **aac**

- **speex**

- **mp3**

SampleRate.description:
The sample rate of the audio stream for a real-time meeting. Valid values: 8000 and 16000.

- **8000**: call center scenarios

- **16000**: real-time meeting audio capture

ProgressiveCallbacksEnabled.title: Specifies whether to enable the callback feature. To enable this feature, you must configure the callback type and URL in the console and set this parameter to true when creating the job.
ProgressiveCallbacksEnabled.description: Enable callback notifications. To use callbacks, configure the callback type and endpoint in the console, and set this parameter to true when creating the task.

MultipleStreamsEnabled.title: Specifies whether to enable multi-channel audio stream recognition. This setting is only relevant in real-time recording scenarios and defaults to false.
MultipleStreamsEnabled.description: Enable multi-channel audio stream recognition. Use this only for real-time recording. Default is false.

TaskId.title: The TaskId returned when you create a real-time record. You can use this ID to end the real-time recording. Set this parameter only when ending a real-time record; do not set it at other times.
TaskId.description: The TaskId returned when you create a real-time recording. Use this ID to end the recording. Set this parameter only when ending a real-time recording.

OutputPath.title: After configuring OSS information in the console, you can specify an OSS write path to directly save results to your custom OSS bucket.
OutputPath.description: After you configure OSS settings in the console, specify an OSS path to save results directly to your OSS bucket.

LanguageHints.description: Preferred languages. This applies only when SourceLanguage is multilingual. It restricts the output language of the model.
LanguageHints.title: Preferred languages. Takes effect only when SourceLanguage="multilingual" and restricts the output languages of the model.

AudioChannelMode.title: Multi-channel audio and video processing pattern.
AudioChannelMode.description: Multi-channel audio or video processing mode.

Parameters.description: Algorithm-related parameters for the task. Set these as needed.

TargetAudioFormat.description: Convert the original audio or video file or audio stream to MP3 format. Only MP3 is supported. Optional for offline transcription or real-time meetings.

TargetVideoFormat.description: Convert the original video file to MP4 format. Only MP4 is supported. Use this only for offline transcription when the source file is a video. Usually not required.

VideoThumbnailEnabled.description: Extract and save thumbnails from the original video file. Use this only for offline transcription when the source file is a video. Usually not required.

SpectrumEnabled.description: Generate and save a waveform image for the original audio or video file or audio stream. Only MP3 is supported. Optional for offline transcription or real-time meetings.

AudioEventDetectionEnabled.description: Enable audio event detection during speech transcription. This detects events such as music in the audio.

SpeakerCount.description:
Set the number of speakers for diarization.

If not set: Do not distinguish speaker roles.

0: Detect an unknown number of speakers.

2: Detect exactly two speakers.

OutputLevel.title: Set the speech recognition result return level. 1: Return the recognition result when a complete sentence is detected; 2: Return the recognition result when intermediate results and complete sentences are detected
OutputLevel.description:
Set the level of speech recognition results. Default is 1.

- **1**: Return results only when complete sentences are recognized.

- **2**: Return results for both partial and complete sentences.

enumValueTitles.1: Return results only when complete sentences are recognized.
enumValueTitles.2: Return results for both partial and complete sentences.

AdditionalStreamOutputLevel.title: Set the Level at which speech recognition Results for active speakers are returned in real-time recording scenarios. 1: Return the Result when a complete sentence is detected; 2: Return the Result when intermediate results or a complete sentence are detected (applicable only in real-time recording scenarios when MultipleStreamsEnabled=true; not required for offline transcription scenarios).
AdditionalStreamOutputLevel.description:
Set the level of speech recognition results for the active speaker in real-time recording.

- **1**: Return results only when complete sentences are recognized.

- **2**: Return results for both partial and complete sentences.

Use this only for real-time recording when MultipleStreamsEnabled is true. Not required for offline transcription.

enumValueTitles.1: Return results only when complete sentences are recognized.
enumValueTitles.2: Return results for both partial and complete sentences.

PhraseId.title: Hotword ID
PhraseId.description: The ID of the hotword list.

Model.title: Set the speech transcription model to improve transcription accuracy in specific domains.
Model.description: Set the speech transcription model to improve accuracy for specific domains.

ProfanityFilterEnabled.title: Whether to enable the sensitive word filtering feature during speech transcription. Enabled by default.
ProfanityFilterEnabled.description: Enable sensitive word filtering during speech transcription. Enabled by default.

TargetLanguages.description: Target languages for translation. Supported languages: Chinese, English, and Japanese.

items.description:
Target languages for translation. Valid values:

- **cn**: Chinese

- **en**: English

- **ja**: Japanese

OutputLevel.title: Set the level of real-time language translation result output. 1: Return the classification result when a complete sentence is detected; 2: Return the classification result when intermediate results or a complete sentence are detected (set only as needed in real-time recording scenarios; not required for offline transcription scenarios).
OutputLevel.description:
Set the level of translation results. Default is 1.

- **1**: Return results only when complete sentences are translated.

- **2**: Return results for both partial and complete sentences.

Use this only for real-time recording. Not required for offline transcription.

AdditionalStreamOutputLevel.title: Set the level for returning language translation recognition results corresponding to the active speaker in real-time recording scenarios. 1: Return the classification result when a complete sentence is detected; 2: Return the classification result when intermediate results and complete sentences are detected (only applicable in real-time recording scenarios when MultipleStreamsEnabled=true; not required in offline transcription scenarios).
AdditionalStreamOutputLevel.description:
Set the level of translation results for the active speaker in real-time recording.

- **1**: Return results only when complete sentences are translated.

- **2**: Return results for both partial and complete sentences.

Use this only for real-time recording when MultipleStreamsEnabled is true. Not required for offline transcription.

enumValueTitles.1: Return results only when complete sentences are translated.
enumValueTitles.2: Return results for both partial and complete sentences.

AutoChaptersEnabled.description: Enable chapter summaries. When enabled, the system generates chapter titles and summaries.

MeetingAssistanceEnabled.description: Enable smart meeting minutes. When enabled, the system generates keywords, key points, and action items.

MeetingAssistance.description: Smart meeting minutes control parameters. Supports action items, keywords, and key points. If you enable MeetingAssistanceEnabled but do not specify algorithm types in MeetingAssistance, all features run by default.
MeetingAssistance.title: Control parameters for the Intelligent Meeting Summary feature, which supports algorithmic processing of to-do items, keywords, and key content. If you enable MeetingAssistanceEnabled but do not specify algorithm types via MeetingAssistance, all types will be invoked and returned by default.

Types.description: When enabling smart meeting features, specify the feature types. Valid values: Actions (action items) and KeyInformation (keywords and key points).
Types.title: When the Intelligent Meeting Summary feature is enabled, you must specify the desired parameter types. Supported types include Actions and KeyInformation. KeyInformation includes keywords and key content (key sentences).

items.description:
Set the smart meeting minutes algorithm type. Valid values:

- **Actions**: action items

- **KeyInformation**: key information, including keywords and key points

enumValueTitles.KeyInformation: Key information (including keywords and key points)

SummarizationEnabled.description: Enable summarization. When enabled, the system generates full-text summaries and speaker summaries.

Types.description: When enabling summarization, specify the summary type. Valid values: Paragraph (full-text summary), Conversational (speaker summary), and QuestionsAnswering (Q\&A summary).

items.description:

PptExtractionEnabled.title: Whether to enable PPT extraction and PPT summarization. When enabled, it extracts PPT frames from video files and generates corresponding summaries.
PptExtractionEnabled.description: Enable PPT extraction and summarization. When enabled, the system extracts slides from video files and generates summaries. Enable this only for offline transcription when the source file is a video. Results are not generated for real-time recording or for audio-only offline transcription.

TextPolishEnabled.title: Whether to enable Spoken-to-Written Text Polishing. When enabled, the audio transcription results are refined to produce more standardized text output.
